name: Steelix
notes: Painted design: blue-grey stone blocks with lighter grout lines 3 to 4 texels wide, a lighter worn band along each body-segment edge, fine speckled mottling inside the blocks, and _par R rougher on the blocks than in the grout.

So: rock, not brushed metal. Each block is a slightly domed plate with a bevel down into the painted grout; along the bevel the edge is irregular and has a few sparse chips (lighter, rougher); the stone grain is the painted mottling plus a finer grain at the same direction-less character. Nothing dense, no pits on faces.
Black mouth area and the white tooth blocks untouched. Body_emi, flb, flc, flp untouched.
Body shader 3452202033 has no normal sampler and _par is BC1 (no metallic): in game only _dif (with baked cavity) and _par R/G/B load; Body_nor is cache-only.
